latest.title: Nigeria's president approves largest military expansion in recent times
latest.summary: Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu has approved the recruitment of 28,000 additional soldiers and the creation of four new army divisions to address security challenges. The government aims to improve coordination, intelligence sharing, and response times with the new army divisions.
latest.details: Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu has approved the recruitment of 28,000 additional soldiers and the creation of four new army divisions to address security challenges. The government aims to improve coordination, intelligence sharing, and response times with the new army divisions. Three new army headquarters will be established in north-east and central Nigeria, areas affected by Islamist militants, banditry, and farmer-herder clashes. President Tinubu also announced the recruitment of over 50,000 new police officers and allocated a record 5.41tn naira ($4bn; £3bn) to defense and security in the yearly budget.

latest.title: NASA’s ESCAPADE Snaps Family Portrait of Earth, Moon
latest.summary: On July 3, one of NASA’s two Mars-destined ESCAPADE spacecraft captured photos of Earth and the Moon in visible and thermal infrared light. At the time, the spacecraft was 363,250 miles from Earth and 115,600 miles from the Moon, making the Moon appear relatively large.
latest.details: On July 3, one of NASA’s two Mars-destined ESCAPADE spacecraft captured photos of Earth and the Moon in visible and thermal infrared light. At the time, the spacecraft was 363,250 miles from Earth and 115,600 miles from the Moon, making the Moon appear relatively large. The visible light image shows Earth and the Moon as crescents, with only around 8% of each face sunlit. In the thermal infrared image, Earth’s shadowed hemisphere glows at minus 10 to minus 44 degrees Fahrenheit due to its own heat from the atmosphere and surface.

brief_methodology.pl: Komentarz powstaje wyłącznie z przeczytanego tekstu artykułu. Musi przejść niezależny przegląd AI oraz pełną kontrolę językową; surowy tekst artykułu lub RSS nie może być komentarzem awaryjnym.
brief_methodology.en: A comment is created only from the retrieved article text. It must pass an independent AI review and the complete language gate; raw article or RSS text is never a fallback comment.

urgent_display_methodology: Urgent/Breaking is used as a ranking signal, but it is not shown as the photo badge. The card shows the real editorial category.

comment_quality_gate.pl: Publikowany jest wyłącznie komentarz utworzony z tekstu artykułu, zatwierdzony w niezależnym przeglądzie AI i przyjęty w całości przez rygorystyczną kontrolę językową. Jedno wadliwe zdanie odrzuca cały komentarz.
comment_quality_gate.en: Only an article-derived comment approved by an independent AI review and accepted in full by the strict language gate is published. One defective sentence rejects the whole comment.
